title: Providing for the reappointment of Roger W. Ferguson as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.
official_summary: This joint resolution provides for the reappointment of Roger W. Ferguson as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.

summary.headline: Congress reappoints Roger W. Ferguson to another term as a citizen member of the Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents.
summary.what_it_does: This joint resolution reappoints Roger W. Ferguson as a citizen regent on the Board of Regents, the governing board of the Smithsonian Institution.
